title: Probation results distribution command
description: The closed inbound message on probation.requests, one per resulted regular hearing share. The informant register contract verbatim: only $id, title and descriptions differ (design Appendix B.1).

source.description: The publishing system; half of the idempotency key.

requestId.description: Deterministic UUID derived from hearingId, hearingDay and sharedTime.

hearingId.description: The resulted hearing; forms the cache keys and the results query path.

hearingDay.description: The hearing day of this share (YYYY-MM-DD).

sharedTime.description: When the hearing was shared, as an ISO-8601 instant.

eventType.description: Hearing_Resulted only; any other value is rejected.

userId.description: The sharing user. Optional: absence is valid, explicit null is refused. Not part of the request fingerprint.
